We are implementing the Bash tool for the Anthropic Computer Use Spec. @Web 

Fix this bug...

The `execute_shell_command` function attempts to call `.get_output()` and `.is_restart()` methods on the `BashResult` enum, which are missing, causing compilation errors. Additionally, the `CommandResult` always reports `success: true` when `bash_command` returns `Ok`, failing to check the actual success status of the underlying shell command and leading to incorrect success reporting for failed commands.
